#HYDTPinfo 
🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚦
In view of the ongoing Steel Flyover & Underpass construction works under H-CITI at Jubilee Hills Check Post, KBR Park Entrance, and Mugdha Junction, pillar works will commence at Road No. 2, Banjarahills under the limits of  @shotr_bhills  from 27-02-2026.
👉 TRAFFIC DIVERSION & ALTERNATE ROUTES
1️⃣ From NFCL → Srinagar Colony / Sagar Society / KBR Park / Jubilee Hills Check Post / Rd 36 & 45 / Cable Bridge
• Diversion at Srinagar Colony T-Junction & Sagar Society
• Proceed via Srinagar Colony Main Road → Indiranagar Labour Adda → Rd No.5 Jubilee Hills → Venkatagiri X Roads (Rd No.10 Jubilee Hills) → Left towards Jubilee Hills Check Post
2️⃣ From Rd 36 & 45 Jubilee Hills → NFCL
• Diversion at Jubilee Hills Check Post → Venkatagiri Rd No.2 → Yousufguda Basti → Yousufguda Check Post → Maitrivanam → Ameerpet → Indiranagar Labour Adda → Srinagar Colony → Value Zone → Panjagutta Main Road
3️⃣ From KCP & Rd No.1 Banjara Hills → KBR Park / Jubilee Hills Check Post / Rd 36
• Take Rd No.10 Banjara Hills → Cancer Hospital → Left via Agrasen Island → Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan → Rd No.45 Jubilee Hills
4️⃣ From Masab Tank → KBR Park / Jubilee Hills Check Post
• Left at Virinchi Hospital → Agrasen Island → Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan → Rd No.45 Jubilee Hills
⚠️ Note: Diversions will be implemented only on a need basis.
🙏 Motorists are requested to plan travel accordingly and follow traffic police instructions.
#TrafficAdvisory #HyderabadTraffic #TrafficDiversion #RoadSafety #DriveSafe
